Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including detailed building and site data, portables, and specialized spaces (e.g., STEAM labs, athletic fields). Robust condition assessments with detailed project prioritization and lifecycle considerations (Sections 5, 6, and site summaries).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Detailed enrollment data by grade and ethnicity with long-term projections and capacity utilization analysis linked to specific facility projects and adaptive uses (Sections 1, 5).

Educational Alignment.justification: Educational alignment is a core organizing principle with detailed educational specifications for all school levels, integration of SV Innovates initiative, and direct connection of facility projects to educational goals and programs (Section 7a and SV Innovates sections).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: Plan includes data and analysis of outdoor spaces, shade structures, outdoor learning areas, and greening strategies at multiple sites, but lacks districtwide comprehensive data on green space coverage or detailed climate resilience framing (Sections 5 and site projects).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Acknowledges climate-related risks and includes some mitigation strategies such as shade structures and stormwater management, but lacks comprehensive districtwide climate risk assessment or integrated climate resilience as a central theme (Sections 5 and site projects).

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Includes energy efficiency upgrades, LED lighting, HVAC replacements, and references to Title 24 compliance; mentions energy resilience goals but lacks comprehensive districtwide energy resilience strategy or detailed electrification plans (Sections 5, 6, and construction standards).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Presents a detailed, comprehensive financial plan with itemized cost estimates, prioritization framework, multiple funding sources including bonds and developer fees, and long-term sustainability considerations (Section 6 Financial Summary).
